entities.summary: Dmytro Viktorovych Yakushyn is a Ukrainian former professional ice hockey player. He also played two games for the Toronto Maple Leafs in the 1999–00 season. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1998 to 2013, was spent in the minor leagues and then later in Europe. Internationally Yakushyn played for the Ukrainian national team in three World Championships. As a youth, he played in the 1992 Quebec International Pee-Wee Hockey Tournament with a team from Kharkiv.
